title: The Supplier Swap
brief: Meridian Build procurement proposes switching the cladding panel supplier on a hospital car park project to save 8 percent. Change request PC-19 goes to the project board on Thursday. You have 12 visit points to assess the change for risks, controls, and records.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Designer: has the new product been reviewed
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Test certificates for the new panels
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: PC-19 states the reason, the scope, and the approvers.
New supplier evaluation form SE-88 has only price completed; quality, capacity, and past performance are blank.
evidence.whyItMatters: External providers must be evaluated against defined criteria.
evidence.missedExplanation: Read every section of the evaluation.

evidence.text: Specification lists panel performance and finish requirements.
Designer: "We haven't seen the new panel data." No design review of product NP-40 is recorded.
Contract clause 22 requires client approval for any product substitution; PC-19 has no client step.
Test certificates for NP-40 cover fire classification only for a thinner panel (certificate TC-2 for 18 mm, specified 25 mm).
evidence.whyItMatters: Verification evidence must match the product supplied.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check certificates match the actual product.

evidence.text: Installer: "The new panels use a different bracket. We haven't been trained on it." No training is listed in PC-19.
evidence.whyItMatters: Training needed for the new method.

evidence.text: Method statement MS-6 refers to the old supplier's brackets only.
evidence.whyItMatters: Documents need updating with the change.

evidence.text: Lead times for both suppliers are within programme.

evidence.whyItMatters: Marketing is not evidence either way.
evidence.falseFindingNote: Marketing claims are not a finding.

decisions.prompt: What should the board decide on Thursday?
options: Defer with conditions: full supplier evaluation, design review, certificates for the specified product, client approval, method statement and training
Approve and tell the client later
Reject all supplier changes in future
decisions.rationale: The saving is possible only once the review is complete.

containment: Keep the current supplier until PC-19 is approved
correction: Complete evaluation, design review, certificates, client approval, MS-6 update, and training
cause: The procurement change process can reach the board on price alone
corrective: Require design, quality, and client approval steps before a substitution reaches the board
effectiveness: Audit the next five substitution requests

debriefText.found: You assessed supplier, design, certificates, client, and method.
debriefText.missed: Check certificates match the exact product specified.
debriefText.falseFinding: Brochure claims and agenda order are not findings.
